task_summary: Reach and grasp a filled 500 mL water bottle (0.4 kg payload) from Pickup Station A, lift and transfer it upright across the workspace at full horizontal extension, and place it onto Target Station B without spilling.

phases.name: approach_and_grasp
phases.description: Reach from home posture to Pickup Station A and close parallel gripper fingers around the 500 mL water bottle.

phases.name: extended_bottle_lift_and_transfer
phases.description: Lift and carry the 0.4 kg water bottle upright across a full-extension arc (moment arm ~0.61 m) toward Target Station B.

phases.name: place_bottle_and_release
phases.description: Controlled placement of the water bottle onto Target Station B coaster, gripper release, and retraction.

critical_moments.reason: Maximum horizontal moment arm (~0.61 m) while carrying the 0.4 kg water bottle upright creates peak J2 shoulder pitch torque demand (3.11 N·m required, ratio 1.13 > 0.80 limit).
Simultaneous J2 upward lift velocity and bottle gravity load pushes XM430-W350 beyond its torque-speed boundary and 1.35 N·m continuous thermal rating (RMS ratio 1.73).
